preformAction(GameAction) - Method in class com.hottes.caleb.ultimateticktacktoe.gameindependant.GameState
This method tries to set the value in the state array at the speficifed location to the marker value If the action is not on the board, ie less than 0 or greater than m board size then a normal arrayindex out of bounds is thrown This method does NOT check if the action is legal according the the games rules this method is itended to do whatever is nessacary to prepare the board for the next move.
